Subject: ACME renewal: forecast sweep & churn signal triage

Hi team,

We need a quick pre-finance sweep on ACME ahead of the Friday forecast lock. Finance flagged this account as a potential churn risk in the monthly model due to a mix of stage drift and an unconfirmed PO date. Can we do the following by EOD Wednesday?

- Verify committed ARR for renewal (what we should carry into the commit column) and call out what is assumed vs. signed.
- Confirm procurement timeline (PO / SOW sign date) or gating blockers.
- Clean up any opportunities in the pipe with stale stage ownership or unclear probability; mark as PASS / AT-RISK / COMMIT.
- Attach a 1-slide quickview showing net ARR delta if ACME moves from Commit -> At-risk.

I attached a quickview template you can drop numbers into (ACME_renewal_quickview.xlsx). I’ll ping Finance if we need a manual adj.

Laura — can you take lead on the committed amount and probability assumptions? Aditya — can you validate who owns the procurement thread and whether legal redlines remain?

Thanks,
Jonas

On Mon, Oct 5, 2026 at 9:12 AM Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com> wrote:
> We need a quick pre-finance sweep on ACME ahead of the Friday forecast lock.

Quick update after pulling SFDC and recent CS notes:

- Committed ARR (current ask): $845,000/year. That is reflected in the Commit column in HubSpot but note $120k of that is conditional on a services SOW that is not signed.
- Probability: HubSpot shows 75% (we should treat as AT-RISK until PO received).
- Procurement owner: Maria Gomez (ACME) + procurement@starlight.io are coordinating. External timeline says "by end of Oct" but that date has slid twice.
- Legal redlines: one remaining clause on data retention; legal shared a condensed extract (attached acme_contract_extract.pdf).
- Suggested action: move $120k to "Contingent" and reduce commit to $725k for Friday unless we get explicit PO/PO date. Mark ACME as "Sales: At-risk -> Finance: Adjusted commit" in the forecast notes.

I populated the quickview and attached it. If Aditya can confirm the PO gating items, I’ll finalize the notes and update HubSpot.

Thanks for the clear summary — appreciate the heads-up. A few items from ACME side: 

- We are still planning to renew but need an updated PO date from procurement. Our legal team is asking for the same data-retention clarification Laura mentioned. If redlines remain, that will push the PO.
- If Redwood can sign a 12-month extension guarantee on pricing and offer a little flexibility on effective date, we can accelerate signing (we have headcount constraints that make Q4 budgeting tight).
- For the $120k services piece: can that be broken into a separate SOW that we finalize post-sign? That would allow the base license to be signed now.

Happy to hop on a 20-min call tomorrow with Laura to unblock the legal question.

Thanks,
Maria Gomez
Director, Platform Procurement
ACME Corp
maria.gomez@acmecorp.com

Thanks Maria — appreciate the candid timeline. Quick plan: 

- Laura and I will separate the base license ($725k) from the services SOW ($120k) in the proposal so procurement can issue a PO for the license alone. That should be sufficient for Finance to carry the license as a Commit if we get a signed PO by Oct 29.
- Legal: Aditya, can you confirm whether the data-retention redline can be handled with a short addendum (we have precedent language in the template)? If yes, we’ll share updated extract by EOD today and offer the 12-month pricing guarantee Maria requested.
- I updated the HubSpot deal and flagged the $120k as Contingent; link here: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/ACME-2026-EXP-47.
- Finance: if we do not receive a PO by Oct 29, reduce Commit by $120k in the 10/29 lock and show a contingent pipeline item for the SOW.

I attached the updated quickview (ACME_renewal_quickview.xlsx) and the contract extract. Laura — please schedule the 20-min call with Maria when you have availability.
